result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontally scrollable content is visibly clipped at the right edge and the bottom navigation overlaps the scrolling content area.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off at the right edge: part of an additional chip is visible as a blank partial pill, making the horizontal carousel look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal list has appropriate end padding and clear clipping behavior, or size the visible chips so the next item is not shown as an ambiguous sliver.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' restaurant carousel is clipped on the right: the third restaurant card and its text are truncated by the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side carousel padding and/or use intentional peek styling that keeps the partial card readable; avoid clipping restaurant names and delivery details.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the feed; the next restaurant promotion card continues underneath it and is partially obscured at the bottom.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content to account for the bottom navigation and safe-area inset.
